description: Huang Gai, tough old chinese veteran in the supplied pixel art style. White hair in a topknot with a red and white headband and tails, a bare scarred muscular torso, red waist armor with gold trim and a red loincloth, dark boots. He holds a heavy iron chain whip with a weighted ball hanging from the right hand
face: A fierce old face with a big white beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the white topknot with the red headband tails, the bare scarred back, red waist armor, the iron chain hanging at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand holds the weapon ready at the side, the left hand comes forward, the knees bend

actions.idle: Guard with a iron chain whip hanging from the right hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the iron chain whip, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a2: Rising lash. Frames 1-7 the iron chain whip trails low behind; frame 9 it is whipped up from below; frames 10-11 it arcs high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The iron chain whip stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Two lashes. Frames 1-6 wind up; frame 7 the first lash; frames 8-10 it swings back round; frame 11 the second lash. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The iron chain whip stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Downward lash. Frames 1-7 the iron chain whip is swung up over the head; frame 9 it is brought down hard; frames 10-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The iron chain whip stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Self-sacrifice. Frames 1-6 he bows his body and gathers the iron chain whip in; frame 8 he straightens with the arms spread, chest bared, enduring; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The iron chain whip stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.c4: Circling lash. The weapon is swung in one full circle around the body and lashes the target as it comes round to the front; then it is drawn back.
actions.c3: Binding throw. Frames 1-7 the  is circled once above the head; frame 9 it is cast out forward to bind the target; frames 10-12 he pulls it taut and holds.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a2 → b2 → a3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
